mmsi: Maritime Mobile Service Identity, the 9-digit identifier broadcast by the vessel's AIS transponder. Assigned by the flag state, so it changes if the vessel is re-flagged. E.g., 538003913
imo: International Maritime Organization number, a permanent 7-digit identifier that stays with the hull for its whole life, unlike the MMSI. Empty when not known. E.g., 9470959
ship_id: MarineTraffic's own internal vessel identifier. Stable, but specific to this provider. E.g., 713139
lat: Latitude of the reported position in WGS84 decimal degrees, between -90 and 90. E.g., 37.388430
lon: Longitude of the reported position in WGS84 decimal degrees, between -180 and 180. E.g., 23.871230
speed: Speed over ground in tenths of a knot, as broadcast by AIS. Divide by ten to obtain knots: a value of 6 means 0.6 knots.
heading: True heading of the vessel's bow in degrees from true north, 0 to 359. The value 511 means the heading was not available. Differs from course, which is the direction actually travelled.
course: Course over ground in degrees from true north, 0 to 359. The direction the vessel is actually moving, which differs from its heading when it is set by wind or current. E.g., 41
status: AIS navigational status code: 0 = under way using engine, 1 = at anchor, 2 = not under command, 3 = restricted manoeuvrability, 4 = constrained by draught, 5 = moored, 6 = aground.
timestamp: UTC timestamp of the AIS position report. E.g., 2020-10-15T12:21:44.000Z
dsrc: Source of the position report: TER for a terrestrial AIS receiver, SAT for satellite AIS.
utc_seconds: Seconds field of the UTC time at which the position was recorded, as carried in the AIS position report. E.g., 45
market: MarineTraffic's commercial market segment for the vessel. E.g., TANKERS, CONTAINERS, SUPPORTING VESSELS
shipname: Vessel name as broadcast in AIS Message 5. E.g., SUNNY STAR
shiptype: AIS-coded ship type, a numeric code from 0 to 99 defined by ITU-R M.1371. E.g., 89
callsign: Radio call sign allocated to the vessel by the ITU through its flag state. E.g., V7TZ6
flag: Flag state of the vessel as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. E.g., MH for the Marshall Islands
length: Length overall of the vessel in metres. E.g., 184
width: Beam, the maximum width of the vessel, in metres. E.g., 27.43
grt: Gross registered tonnage, a measure of the vessel's total enclosed volume rather than its weight. E.g., 23313
dwt: Deadweight tonnage in metric tons: the total weight of cargo, fuel, stores and crew the vessel can carry. E.g., 37857
draught: Reported draught in tenths of a metre, the depth of the hull below the waterline. Divide by ten for metres: a value of 95 means 9.5 metres.
year_built: Year in which the vessel was built. E.g., 2010
ship_country: Full name of the flag state, as opposed to the two-letter code in the flag column. E.g., Marshall Is
ship_class: MarineTraffic size or design class for the vessel. E.g., HANDYSIZE, AFRAMAX, FEEDER
rot: Rate of turn as broadcast by AIS. A positive value indicates a turn to starboard, a negative value a turn to port, and zero no turn. E.g., 0
type_name: Human-readable MarineTraffic ship-type classification. E.g., Oil/Chemical Tanker
ais_type_summary: Coarse ship-type grouping above the detailed type name. E.g., Tanker, Cargo, Passenger
destination: Free-text destination keyed in by the crew and broadcast in AIS Message 5. Often a UN/LOCODE, sometimes a port name, sometimes a placeholder such as FOR ORDERS.
eta: Estimated time of arrival as broadcast via AIS. Entered manually by the crew and frequently stale. E.g., 2020-10-14T12:00:00.000Z
l_fore: Distance in metres from the bow to the position of the AIS antenna on the vessel. E.g., 5
w_left: Distance in metres from the port side to the position of the AIS antenna on the vessel. E.g., 5
current_port: Name of the port the vessel is currently in, resolved by MarineTraffic. Empty while the vessel is under way. E.g., GDANSK
last_port: Name of the last port the vessel departed from. E.g., AGIOI THEODOROI
last_port_time: UTC timestamp at which the vessel departed the last port. E.g., 2020-10-13T23:39:00.000Z
current_port_id: MarineTraffic internal identifier of the current port. Empty while the vessel is under way.
current_port_unlocode: UN/LOCODE of the current port, the five-character UNECE location code. Empty while the vessel is under way.
current_port_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the current port. Empty while the vessel is under way.
last_port_id: MarineTraffic internal identifier of the last port departed. E.g., 29
last_port_unlocode: UN/LOCODE of the last port departed. E.g., GRAGT for Agioi Theodoroi
last_port_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the last port departed. E.g., GR
next_port_id: MarineTraffic internal identifier of the predicted next port.
next_port_unlocode: UN/LOCODE of the predicted next port. E.g., EETLL for Tallinn
next_port_name: Name of the next port, predicted by MarineTraffic from voyage forecasting rather than broadcast by the vessel. E.g., TALLINN
next_port_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the predicted next port.
eta_calc: Arrival time predicted by MarineTraffic from voyage forecasting, as distinct from the crew-entered value in the eta column.
eta_updated: UTC timestamp at which the predicted arrival time was last recomputed.
distance_to_go: Remaining distance to the destination, in nautical miles. E.g., 0
distance_travelled: Distance covered so far on the current voyage, in nautical miles. E.g., 74
avg_speed: Average speed over the current voyage, in knots. Unlike the raw speed column this is already expressed in knots. E.g., 12.6
max_speed: Maximum speed recorded over the current voyage, in knots. E.g., 13.2
